sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Blood Spiral Base was built upon the original site of the Spiral Mark, an magical sigil created by the Nullifier scout, Void, to signal his brethren to come to Earth. [Words from Eathon] After the Betrayer's attempts to bring back the Nullifiers were thwarted by the children of Lord Casterwill, for centuries, the Base become home to the Blood Spiral, where they waited in the shadows of history, slowly plotting their return. [The Divine Comedy] A portal leading to the Base was set up in the Professor's castle, through which Rassimov went to escape the Huntik team and fake his demise. He then reconvened with Wind and Shauna, having set up the downfall of the Professor. [The Divine Comedy]

Rassimov would regularly wait in the Throne Room to receive orders from the spirit of the Betrayer. The Blooded Circle would also meet here to hear the Betrayer's designs and discuss the Spirals' next move. [Zhalia's Mission] While the expansive training room would be used by the Spiral members to spar with each. Tantras would also train his new recruits in this room. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

On the longest night of the year, Rassimov invoked Void to activate the Spiral Mark, causing the ground of the base to break apart revealing the Spiral Mark beneath them. Zhalia Moon, who had infiltrated the Blood Spiral, was then able to reveal the location to Dante Vale in a sketch using Logosbook. Dante then used Umbra to teleport himself and the rest of the team to the base to fight the Spirals. [Words from Eathon] The Huntik Foundation and Casterwill family alliance also travelled to the base in the Scramjets and waged a huge final battle against the Blood Spiral. [The Spiral Mark] During the battle between Harrison and Den Fears, the throne room completely broke apart, with the Betrayer's throne rising up from the base and breaking out onto the surface. [Lok and the Betrayer] Following the defeat of the Betrayer, the Spiral Mark site and the surrounding base were kept under guard by the Huntik Foundation. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Rooms
sections.text:
• The Throne Room - the main area in the base where the corpse of the Betrayer sits and gives orders directly to Rassimov. The members of the Blooded Circle convene here to receive orders, discuss the Betrayer's plans and devise the Blood Spiral's next moves. [Zhalia's Mission]
• Training Area - This is a large cave where Tantras can train his new recruits and the Silent Soldiers can brutally spa against one another. [Boys Will Be Seekers]
• Living Quarters - the Blood Spiral members live in small dormitories with simple beds, lit by candlelight. [Rassimov's Secret]
